:- module(main, [main/0]).
:- use_module(library(readutil)).

read_grid(N, Grid) :-
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, Line1),
    ( Line1 == end_of_file -> Grid = []
    ; length(Grid, N), fill_rows(Grid, Line1)
    ).

fill_rows([], _).
fill_rows([Row|Rest], Prev) :-
    ( Row == '-' -> Row = Prev
    ; true ),
    fill_rows(Rest, Prev).

main :-
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, NLine),
    NLine \== end_of_file,
    parse_number(NLine, N),
    read_lines(N, GridCodes),
    maplist(codes_chars, GridCodes, Grid),
    ( Grid == [] -> true
    ; solve(Grid, 0, 0, N, Result),
      atom_chars(ResultAtom, Result),
      write(ResultAtom), nl
    ),
    halt.

parse_number(Codes, N) :-
    number_codes(N, Codes).

read_lines(0, []).
read_lines(N, [Line|Rest]) :-
    N > 0,
    read_line_to_codes(user_input, Line),
    ( Line == end_of_file -> Rest = []
    ; N1 is N - 1, read_lines(N1, Rest)
    ).

codes_chars([], []).
codes_chars([C|Cs], [H|T]) :- char_code(H, C), codes_chars(Cs, T).

solve(Grid, R, C, Size, Result) :-
    nth0(R, Grid, Row),
    nth0(C, Row, First),
    ( all_same(Grid, R, C, Size, First)
    -> Result = [First]
    ; Half is Size // 2,
      R2 is R + Half, C2 is C + Half,
      solve(Grid, R, C, Half, TL),
      solve(Grid, R, C2, Half, TR),
      solve(Grid, R2, C, Half, BL),
      solve(Grid, R2, C2, Half, BR),
      append([TL, TR, BL, BR], Inner),
      Result = ['(', Inner, ')']
    ).

all_same(_, _, _, 0, _).
all_same(Grid, R, C, Size, First) :-
    Size > 0,
    nth0(R, Grid, Row),
    nth0(C, Row, First),
    C1 is C + 1, Size1 is Size - 1,
    row_same(Row, C, Size, First),
    R1 is R + 1,
    all_same(Grid, R1, C, Size1, First).

row_same(_, _, 0, _).
row_same(Row, C, Size, First) :-
    nth0(C, Row, First),
    C1 is C + 1, Size1 is Size - 1,
    row_same(Row, C1, Size1, First).

append([], []).
append([H|T], L) :- append(H, L).
append([], L, L).
append([H|T], L2) :- append(H, L3, L2), append(T, L3, L2).
